rules: A short comedy or suspense sketch acted by the characters: natural spoken lines, max about 80 characters each, punchy.
Beat 1 is the hook: a big on-screen text (7 words or fewer) plus a line or strong reaction.
The twist lands in the last third; the last beat loops visually or verbally back to the first.
In every line wrap 1-3 key words in *asterisks*. No emoji.
